---

Supplement mirroring the loaloa example in the main paper. See the
`adlaplaceFem` package vignette `vignettes/loaloa.Rmd` for the full fit.

```{r setup}
library(adlaplaceFem)
library(geostatsp)
library(terra)
data("loaloa", package = "geostatsp")
loaloa <- terra::unwrap(loaloa)
```

```{r knots}
coarse <- geostatsp::squareRaster(loaloa, cells = 6, buffer = 300 * 1000)
west <- terra::rast(
  terra::ext(c(3.9e5, 8.1e5, 3.7e5, 7.7e5)),
  resolution = 75 * 1000
)
east <- terra::rast(
  terra::ext(c(9.9e5, 1.19e6, 3.7e5, 7.7e5)),
  resolution = 75 * 1000
)
knots_grid <- list(coarse, list(west, east))
hb_summary(hb_knots(knots_grid, degree = 3L))
```

The model uses `adlaplaceFem::matern(geometry, knots = knots_grid, shape = 2L)`.
